business.description: Renewal flow covers existing GQ customers returning to renew — Welcome Back pre-fill + Verify Details review must be tested end-to-end
Student Details and Choose Plan pages are shared with application creation flow — renewal variants must use RENEWAL_MOBILE, not APP_CREATION_MOBILE
No changes to application creation flow resource files — renewal pages add WelcomeBackPage.robot and VerifyDetailsPage.robot only

technical.description: data-testid locators exclusively; text= selectors permitted only where data-testid absent (Welcome Back continue/change buttons)
Each renewal suite uses 1 shared browser session: Suite Setup logs in once; Test Setup uses Go To /renewal-confirmation or /renewal-details (no re-login)
verify_details_tests.robot shares 1 application across tests; TC-VD09 (2nd-to-last) submits it; TC-VD25 (last) creates a fresh app within the same session
RENEWAL_MOBILE must be a pre-existing account on UAT with at least one prior application — cannot be auto-generated like APP_CREATION_MOBILE

user_experience.description: Verify Details tests cover skip, edit residential, edit employment, validation errors, and proceed (CONFIRM AND PROCEED) paths
Welcome Back tests assert pre-fill accuracy (student name, course, institution) and both continue/change-applicant navigation paths
Renewal Student Details and Choose Plan tests cover same functional scope as application creation equivalents but with RENEWAL_MOBILE context

security.description: Suite Setup abort-on-auth-failure mandatory — renewal tests must not silently proceed if login or renewal navigation fails

operational.description: RENEWAL_MOBILE must be set as env var before running renewal suites — no auto-generation; value must map to an ERP-registered account with prior application history
All renewal tests tagged with 'renewal' + suite-specific tag (renewal-journey-flow, welcome-back, verify-details, etc.) for filtered runs

validation_criteria: verify_details_tests.robot Suite Setup creates one shared application and navigates to /renewal-details
TC-VD01–VD08 use Test Setup Go To /renewal-details (shared app still open)
TC-VD09 uses [Setup] NONE and submits the shared application
TC-VD25 uses a fresh application created within the session — not affected by TC-VD09 submission

propagation_effects.note: TC-VD09 must remain 2nd-to-last; TC-VD25 must remain last — test order is load-bearing in verify_details_tests.robot

validation_criteria: student_details_tests.robot and choose_plan_tests.robot under renewal_journey_flow/ use RENEWAL_MOBILE variable
RENEWAL_MOBILE is documented as a required pre-existing account — env var, not auto-generated
Renewal suite Setup keywords navigate to /student-details via renewal path, not application creation path

propagation_effects.note: CI pipeline must inject RENEWAL_MOBILE before running renewal suites — failure to do so causes Suite Setup to fail with account-not-found error

binding_constraint.reason: Without WelcomeBackPage.robot and VerifyDetailsPage.robot resource files, no Welcome Back or Verify Details test can execute. These are the net-new renewal-specific pages; StudentDetailsPage and ChoosePlanPage already exist from the application creation flow.

convergence.note: All 4 required truths satisfied. WelcomeBackPage.robot and VerifyDetailsPage.robot confirmed on disk. 46 renewal journey flow tests confirmed (TC-R5001–R5007, TC-R6001–R6008, TC-WB01–WB06, TC-VD01–VD25). No open gaps.
